name: useCloudHardwareAgent
summary: Multi-turn Gemini tool-calling loop over the capability adapter you pass to each ask().
plain: Runs a loop with Gemini in the cloud: the model can call the tools in the capability adapter you pass, the hook runs them on the device and sends the results back, until the model answers or the step limit is reached.
description: Wraps runCloudAgent from @google/genai: ask() sends the prompt and the conversation so far, executes each model tool call through runTool against run.capabilityAdapter, folds the results back into the next turn, and stops when the model answers, maxSteps (default DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS, 6) is reached, the run is cancelled, or no capability or API key is available. The default model is the DEFAULT_AGENT_MODEL constant. Intermediate tool steps are reported in steps and final text in lastResponse. The hook does not request or surface model thoughts.

params.name: defaultOptions
params.desc: Optional defaults merged under each ask() run: model, systemInstruction, temperature, maxSteps and onStep. Per-ask values win. The adapter and trace context are not defaults; they are passed to ask().

returns.name: isRunning
returns.desc: Whether the autonomous reasoning loop is actively executing multi-turn tool steps.

returns.name: steps
returns.desc: Ordered list of tool execution steps taken by the model during the latest execution.

returns.name: lastResponse
returns.desc: Latest response text returned by the cloud agent.

returns.name: lastResult
returns.desc: Complete result payload of the last agent execution including stop reason.

returns.name: history
returns.desc: Full conversation turn history with model tool calls and function outputs.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if agent initialization, network, or execution failed.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: 'hardware' when an API key is present, otherwise 'unavailable'. It records that a cloud call is possible, not that device hardware was read; the tools run against the adapter you pass.

returns.name: ask
returns.desc: Runs the tool-calling loop. run.capabilityAdapter and run.context are required; an adapter with no tools resolves with stoppedReason 'unavailable' and unavailableReason 'capability_adapter_empty'.

returns.name: reset
returns.desc: Resets the agent memory, step history, and conversation state.

actions.name: ask(prompt, run)
actions.desc: Runs the multi-turn tool-calling loop for one prompt against run.capabilityAdapter.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.desc: The user request. A blank prompt resolves null.

inputs.name: run
inputs.desc: { capabilityAdapter: CapabilityAdapter; context: TraceContext; model?; systemInstruction?; maxSteps?; temperature?; signal?: AbortSignal; onStep?; sink?; redaction? }.

actions.output: Resolves with { text, contents, steps, totalSteps, stoppedReason: 'completed' | 'max_steps_exceeded' | 'unavailable' | 'cancelled', context, unavailableReason?, providerRequestId?, usage? }, or null for a blank prompt or when the loop threw (reason in error). A missing API key or empty adapter resolves with stoppedReason 'unavailable'.

actions.name: reset()
actions.desc: Clears agent memory, step history, and conversation turns.

agentNote: Requires a Gemini API key and a capability adapter with at least one tool; otherwise ask() resolves with stoppedReason 'unavailable'. The model only sees the tools in the adapter you pass; tool results are what the hooks reported, and failed effects come back as errors.
